data.title: Exail Delays Half-Year Results as Profits Surge and Thales Deal Weighs on Accounting
data.description:
Exail Technologies ( (FR:EXA) ) has issued an announcement.

Exail Technologies, a high-tech defense specialist in autonomous robotics and navigation systems, reported strong first-half 2026 operating momentum and revised the release date of its half-year results to September 24 from September 15. The company’s growth is underpinned by robust demand for its maritime drone systems and inertial navigation solutions, particularly in defense markets, where it maintains a broad international footprint and multiple stock market index inclusions.

For the first half of 2026, Exail expects revenue to have risen 27% on a comparable basis, with order intake in navigation systems up more than 40% and photonics activities growing nearly 70%. Preliminary figures indicate current EBITDA of about €63 million, up roughly 43% year on year, and operating income of €46 million, a 61% increase, while cash generation was temporarily weighed down by a €70 million rise in working capital that management attributes to normal seasonality and anticipates being offset by substantial cash inflows in the second half.
